class.name: LatticeContainer
class.brief_description: A container that arranges its child controls in a grid layout, with a given number of rows or columns.
class.description: [LatticeContainer] arranges its child controls in a grid layout. The number of columns/rows [member limit_mode] is specified by the [member limit] property, whereas the number of rows/columns depends on how many are needed for the child controls. The number of rows and columns is preserved for every size of the container. [b]Note:[/b] [LatticeContainer] only works with child nodes inheriting from [Control]. It won't rearrange child nodes inheriting from [Node2D].

members.member: The number of columns/rows in the [LatticeContainer]. When modified, [LatticeContainer] reorders its Control-derived children to accommodate the new layout.
The limit mode. See [enum LimitMode] for details.

constants.constant: Limit used for number of columns.
Limit used for number of rows.
